blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) requires an embodied agent to find an instance of a specified category in an unseen environment and stop near it. The agent typically relies on an object detector but must judge online from a limited egocentric video stream, sometimes a single frame, whether a detected candidate is the target. Detectors often confidently mistake similar objects, such as a sofa for a bed, and stopping at a false positive fails the episode. Prevailing systems also approach candidates greedily, leaving them occluded or partially observed. We present CLOSER, an evidence-aware active verification framework that treats stopping as closed-loop evidence acquisition, coupling vision-language model (VLM) verification with active perception. CLOSER fine-tunes an open-source VLM to label each view of a candidate tracked across frames as target, non-target, or uncertain, selects complementary views with an embedding-based diversity gate, and fuses their per-view probabilities with a lightweight network. If the fused judgment remains uncertain, a diffusion policy drives the agent toward the candidate using only the tracked mask and depth until the decision becomes decisive. CLOSER runs locally and plugs into existing ObjectNav systems without retraining them. On Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D, it raises average success rate by 3.6 points and success weighted by path length by 2.0 points, showing that verifying evidence before committing improves embodied navigation.
blocks.zh: 对象-目标导航(ObjectNav)要求一个被体现的代理在看不见的环境中找到一个特定类别的实例并停止靠近它. 毒剂一般依靠物体探测器,但必须在网上从有限的自我中心视频流(有时是单帧)判断,是否检测到的候选人是目标. 探测器经常自信地误读类似的物体,如一张床的沙发,而停留在假阳性上会使剧集失败. 现行制度也以贪婪的方式对待候选人,使他们处于或部分受到观察。 我们提出CLOSER,这是一个了解证据的积极核查框架,将停止作为获取闭路证据、将视觉语言模型(VLM)核查与主动感知相结合。 CLOSER对开源VLM进行微调,将跨帧跟踪的候选对象的每个视图标注为目标,非目标,或不确定,选择基于嵌入式多样性门的互补视图,并将其每个视图的概率与轻量级网络连接. 如果经调整的判断仍不确定,则扩散政策会促使代理人只使用履带面具和深度对候选人采取行动,直至作出决定。 CLOSER在当地运行,并插入现有的ObjectNav系统而不对其进行再培训. 在Gibson和Habitat-Matterport 3D上,它使平均成功率提高了3.6点,成功率按路径长度加权了2.0点,表明在承诺改进包含的导航之前核实证据。

blocks.en: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) is a fundamental task in embodied AI [ 1 ] in which an agent searches an unseen environment for an object of a specified target category and stops near it [ 2 , 3 ] . To find the target, the agent must explore the environment efficiently and infer where the target is likely to be located. When an object resembling the target comes into view, the agent must further judge whether it is the target. ObjectNav therefore demands both efficient exploration and reliable perception from its online egocentric video stream, and remains a challenging problem despite extensive study [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 对象目标导航(ObjectNav)是体现的AI[1]中的一项基本任务,即代理人为特定目标类别的对象搜索一个看不见的环境,并停止靠近它[2,3]. 为了找到目标,毒剂必须有效探索环境,并推断目标可能位于何处. 当一个类似目标的对象出现时,代理人必须进一步判断它是否是目标. 因此ObjectNav要求从网络自负的视频流中进行高效率的探索和可靠的感知,

blocks.en: To meet these demands, prevailing modular systems adopt an exploration strategy to search promising regions and an off-the-shelf object detector to recognize the observed objects [ 2 , 5 , 6 ] . Whenever a candidate for the target category is detected, the agent must decide from limited local observations whether the candidate is the target and hence whether to stop; in the worst case, only a single partial view is available. Since the episode ends once the agent stops, a wrong stop cannot be corrected, and this stopping decision has been identified as a major bottleneck of modular systems [ 7 , 8 ] . Although modern open-vocabulary detectors such as YOLO-World and Grounded-SAM [ 9 , 10 ] achieve high recall on common indoor categories, they frequently mistake semantically similar objects for the target. For example, a sofa observed from a distance may be detected as a bed (Fig. 1 ), and a stool partially occluded by a table may be detected as a chair. Such confusers are often detected with tight bounding boxes and high confidence, so raising the confidence threshold removes true targets before it removes these errors. Therefore, each detected candidate needs to be further verified before the agent commits to a stop.
blocks.zh: 为了满足这些需求,现行模块化系统采用勘探战略,搜索有希望的区域,并使用现成物体探测器识别观测到的物体[2、5、6]。 每当发现目标类别候选人时,代理商必须从有限的当地观察中决定候选人是否是目标,从而决定是否停止;在最坏的情况下,只能有单一的部分观点. 由于剧集一旦代理停止就结束,一个错误的停站无法纠正,这一停站决定被确定为模块化系统的一个主要瓶颈[7,8]. 虽然现代的开放-vocabulary探测器如YOLO-World和Grounded-SAM[9,10]在常见的室内类别上实现了高召回,但它们经常错误地为目标设定类似物体. 例如,从远处观测到的沙发可能被检测为床位(图1),被表格部分占用的凳子可能被检测为椅子. 这种混淆器经常被用紧固的边框和高度的置信度来检测,因此在消除这些错误之前,提高置信度阈值就能消除真正的目标. 因此,在代理人承诺停止之前,需要进一步核实每个被查出的候选人。

blocks.en: To this end, recent systems introduce a closed-source vision–language model (VLM) such as GPT-4o-mini as a verifier that confirms or rejects each detected candidate [ 11 ] . Such a model provides open-world visual reasoning that the detector lacks, and can reject confusers even when the detection confidence is high. However, the verifier is accessible only through a remote API, which incurs per-query cost and latency and leaves its weights unavailable for local adaptation. A smaller open-source VLM avoids these constraints, yet its verification accuracy drops markedly on hard cases such as distant or partially occluded confusers. Moreover, existing verifiers are binary and must decide even when the current view supports neither confirmation nor rejection. Such a forced decision may stop the agent at a non-target or reject a candidate that a closer view could confirm. Recent work has proposed ternary uncertainty scores and explicit not-found outcomes [ 12 , 13 ] , but neither mechanism moves the agent to acquire more views of the candidate for verification.
blocks.zh: 为此,最近的系统采用了一种闭源视觉-语言模型(VLM),如GPT-4o-mini作为验证器,确认或拒绝每个被检测到的候选人[11]. 这种模型提供了探测器缺乏的开放世界视觉推理,即使探测信心很高,也可以拒绝混淆者. 然而,核查员只能通过一个远程API进入,该API会产生每桶水的成本和耐久性,使其重量无法用于当地适应。 较小的开源VLM可以避免这些限制,但其核实准确度却明显下降于遥远或部分被占用的混淆者等硬性病例. 此外,现有的核查者是二进制的,即使目前的观点既不支持确认也不支持拒绝,也必须决定. 这种强制决定可能会阻止代理人进入非目标,或者拒绝更接近观点可以证实的候选人。 最近的工作提出了暂时不确定分数和明确未找到的结果[12、13],但这两个机制都无法使代理人获得对核查候选人的更多看法。

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose CLOSER (Closed-Loop Observation Sensing for Embodied veRification), an evidence-aware active verification framework in which the agent decides whether to stop by reasoning over the visual evidence on a candidate and acting to improve it. Our key insight is that a reliable stopping decision depends not only on what the candidate appears to be but also on whether the available views suffice to identify it, and this sufficiency depends on the spatial relationship between the agent and the candidate, including its distance, viewing angle, and degree of occlusion. The agent therefore commits to a decision only when the evidence suffices and otherwise approaches the candidate to acquire more informative views (Fig. 1 ). Realizing this closed loop poses two challenges. First, the agent must learn when its evidence is insufficient, which confidence cannot reveal since distant or occluded views often yield confident predictions. Second, it must learn how to reach a more informative view without a complete map of the unseen environment.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提议建立封闭观测仪(Closeed-Loop Observation for Embody verrification),这是一个了解证据的积极核查框架,由代理人决定是否停止对候选人的视觉证据进行推理,并采取行动加以改进。 我们的关键见解是,一个可靠的停止决定不仅取决于候选人看起来是什么,而且取决于现有的意见是否足以确定这一点,这种充分性取决于代理人与候选人之间的空间关系,包括其距离、视角和隔离程度。 因此,代理人只有在证据足够时才作出裁判,否则就要求候选人获得更翔实的意见(图1)。 认识到这种封闭循环构成两个挑战。 首先,代理人必须了解其证据不足时的情况,而这种证据是无法显示的,因为遥远或隐蔽的观点往往产生自信的预测。 第二,它必须学会如何在不绘制完整的看不见环境地图的情况下,达成一个更加翔实的观点。

blocks.en: To learn when the evidence is insufficient, CLOSER fine-tunes an open-source VLM with LoRA [ 14 ] to assess both the identity of the candidate and the sufficiency of each view. During navigation, CLOSER tracks the candidate across egocentric frames with ByteTrack [ 15 ] and caches complementary views of it, and a lightweight MLP fuses the per-view assessments of the VLM to decide whether the evidence suffices. To learn how to reach a more informative view, CLOSER imitates an expert that plans maximum-clearance paths along the Voronoi medial axis of the complete map and smooths them into Bézier trajectories, so that walls are less likely to occlude the candidate along the way. To eliminate this dependence on the map, we distill the expert trajectories into a Diffusion Transformer policy [ 16 , 17 ] that conditions only on the tracked candidate mask and depth, which encode the distance and visibility of the candidate relative to the agent. As the agent follows this policy, verification and active perception form a closed loop, in which every view cached along the trajectory refines the assessment and the approach phase ends as soon as the evidence supports a decision. CLOSER is invoked only when a candidate for the target category is detected and leaves the exploration and mapping components of existing ObjectNav systems unchanged. It can therefore be inserted into these systems as a plug-in verification layer without retraining them.
blocks.zh: 为了了解证据不足,CLOSER对LORA[14]的开源VLM进行了微调,以评估候选人的身份和每种观点是否充分. 在导航过程中,CLOSER用ByteTrack[15]追踪到候选人横跨以自我为中心的帧,并缓存对其的补充观点,一个轻量级的MLP将VLM的每个视图评估引信,以决定证据是否足够. 为了学习如何达成更丰富的观点,CLOSER模仿一位专家,他计划沿着完整地图的沃罗诺伊中轴线进行最大限度的清除路径,并将其平滑为贝塞尔轨迹,这样一来墙壁就不太可能沿途占据候选人. 为了消除这种对地图的依赖,我们把专家的轨迹提炼成一种传播变形器政策[16,17],即仅以履带式候选人面具和深度为条件,将候选人相对于代理人的距离和能见度编码. 随着代理人遵循这一政策,核查和主动感知形成了一个闭合的循环,沿轨迹缓存的每一个视图都会完善评估,一旦证据支持决定,方法阶段就会结束. 只有在检测到目标类别的候选对象并保持现有ObjectNav系统的勘探和绘图组件不变时,才会引用CLOSER. 因此,可以在不对其进行再培训的情况下作为插件核查层插入这些系统。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are summarized as follows: • We propose CLOSER, a plug-in layer for existing ObjectNav systems that formulates the stopping decision as an active verification problem. Closer judges not only whether a candidate is the target but also whether its views suffice for that judgment, and it drives the agent to acquire more views by approaching the candidate when the current views are insufficient. • Since a confident prediction on a distant or occluded view can be wrong, we design the verifier in Closer to assess the sufficiency of each view in addition to the identity of the candidate. We fine-tune an open-source VLM for this assessment under a closed-source VLM teacher and train a lightweight MLP that fuses the assessments of complementary views into a single decision. • We train a map-free approach policy by distilling an expert into a Diffusion Transformer that generates a trajectory toward the candidate from its tracked mask and depth. To keep the candidate in view throughout the approach phase, the expert plans each path along the Voronoi medial axis of the free space for maximum clearance from walls and smooths the path into a Bézier trajectory. • Simulation experiments confirm that CLOSER improves ObjectNav performance. Across diverse ObjectNav systems on Gibson, HM3D v1, and HM3D v2, CLOSER improves success rate (SR), with an average gain of 3.6 points and a maximum gain of 4.9 points. CLOSER also improves success weighted by path length (SPL) by 2.0 points on average.
blocks.zh: • 本文件的主要贡献概述如下: 我们建议CLOSER作为现有ObjectNav系统的插件层,将停止决定作为一个积极的核查问题。 更密切地判断候选人是否是目标,判断其观点是否足以作出这一判决,并促使代理人在当前意见不足时与候选人接触,从而获得更多观点。 • 支助 由于对远视或隐蔽视线的自信预测可能是错误的,我们设计了更接近视线的验证器,以评估每个视线是否充足,以及候选人的身份. 在封闭源码VLM教师的领导下,我们为这项评估微调一个开源的VLM,并培训一个轻量级的MLP,将补充观点的评估纳入一个单一的决定中。 我们通过将一位专家提炼成一个传播变形器来训练一个无地图方法政策,这个变形器从履带式面具和深度产生一个向候选人的轨迹。 为了使候选人在整个接近阶段保持观察,专家计划沿着自由空间的沃罗诺伊中轴线走的每一条道路,以便从墙壁上进行最大程度的清除,并将道路滑入贝塞尔轨道。 • 模拟实验证实,CLOSER改进了ObjectNav的性能. 在吉布森,HM3D v1和HM3D v2上的各种ObjectNav系统中,CLOSER提高了成功率(SR),平均得分3.6分,最高得分4.9分. CLOSER还提高了成功率,按路径长度(SPL)平均加权2.0点.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Object-Goal Navigation and Target Verification
blocks.zh: II-A 目标导航和目标核查

blocks.en: Existing ObjectNav methods range from end-to-end reinforcement learning, which learns continuous environment representations with multi-step look-ahead planning [ 18 ] or agent-centric relation graphs that encode object layout and target distance [ 19 ] , to modular pipelines that combine semantic mapping with goal selection [ 2 , 3 ] and zero-shot variants [ 4 ] , supported by large-scale simulators [ 20 ] . Recent methods use vision–language models to score exploration frontiers [ 6 ] or large language models to prioritize search regions [ 21 , 22 ] ; E 2 BA [ 23 ] further fuses LLM commonsense scores with geometric costs through particle filtering and uses a cascaded discriminator to decide when to backtrack. These advances concentrate on where to explore, and a separate mechanism is still required to verify whether a detected candidate is the target. For the stopping decision, DITA [ 7 ] decouples depth-based termination from the navigation policy, RATE-Nav [ 8 ] models spatial regions to trigger stopping, and ACRG [ 19 ] encodes the depth-derived agent–target distance into the policy. Classical pipelines verify candidates with detector confidence thresholds [ 2 ] , which fail under partial observability [ 24 ] . Memory [ 3 , 24 ] and blacklist mechanisms [ 25 ] improve decision consistency, SPENav [ 26 ] filters task-irrelevant objects with room-guided semantic priors, and recent systems query a closed-source VLM to verify each candidate [ 11 ] . For image goals, RSRNav [ 27 ] reasons about the spatial relationship between the goal and the current observation through direction-aware correlation and remains robust when the goal viewpoint differs from the test viewpoint. Beyond binary decisions, QAsk-Nav [ 12 ] and VLN-NF [ 13 ] introduce ternary uncertainty scores and an explicit not-found outcome, while IEVE [ 28 ] and DRIVE-Nav [ 29 ] verify potential targets by keypoint matching and cross-frame VLM inspection. However, these systems either depend on closed-source VLM APIs or do not collect further observations when the evidence on a candidate is insufficient. In CLOSER, verification runs on local hardware, and the agent approaches a candidate with insufficient evidence to acquire additional views.
blocks.zh: 现有的ObjectNav方法从端到端的强化学习,学习以多步外观-前瞻规划的连续环境表现[18]或编码对象布局和目标距离的代理-中心关系图[19],到将语义映射与目标选择[2,3]和零射变体[4]相结合的模块化管道,辅以大规模模拟器[20]. 近期的方法使用视觉-语言模型来评分探索前沿[6]或大语言模型来确定搜索区域的优先次序[21,22]; E 2 BA[23]通过粒子过滤进一步将LLM常识分数与几何成本相连接,并使用级联的歧义器来决定何时回溯. 这些进展集中于探索何处,仍然需要一个单独的机制来核实被发现的候选人是否是目标。 对于停止决定,DITA[7]将基于深度的终止与导航政策脱钩,RATE-Nav[8]将启动停止的空间区域模型,ACRG[19]将深度衍生剂-目标距离编码为政策. 古典输油管核查具有探测器置信阈值[2]的候选者,在部分可观察性下失效[24]. 内存[3,24]和黑名单机制[25]提高决策一致性,SPENav[26]过滤与任务相关的对象并带有室制语义前缀,最近系统查询一个闭源VLM以验证每个候选对象[11]. 对于图像目标,RSRNav[27]通过方向感知关联来解释目标与当前观测的空间关系,并在目标视角与测试视角不同时保持强势. 除了二进制决定之外,QAsk-Nav [12]和VLN-NF [13]引入了三进制不确定性分数和明确未找到的结果,而IEVE [28]和DRIVE-Nav [29]则通过关键点匹配和跨框架VLM检查来验证潜在目标. 然而,这些系统要么依赖于封闭源代码的VLM API,要么在候选人的证据不足时不收集进一步的意见. 在CLOSER中,核查是在当地硬件上进行的,代理商接近一个没有足够证据的候选人以获取额外意见.

blocks.en: II-B Vision–Language Model Adaptation and Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
blocks.zh: II-B 愿景-语言模型适应和思维链

blocks.en: Large VLMs can be adapted by training only a small fraction of their parameters, either a lightweight query module with the image encoder and language model frozen [ 30 ] or low-rank updates such as LoRA [ 14 ] , and EverWalker [ 31 ] generates LoRA parameters on the fly from observation prototypes for lifelong navigation. Chain-of-thought supervision provides training signal beyond the final label: CL-CoTNav [ 32 ] fine-tunes a VLM on hierarchical chain-of-thought annotations so that it reasons about ObjectNav decisions, and distilling rationales from closed-source teachers into open models is now standard practice [ 33 , 34 ] . Distillation is likewise used to compress navigation models: Chen et al. [ 35 ] distill both where to look and how to move from a teacher into a student with 93% fewer parameters. However, CURE [ 36 ] shows that VLM rationales can be inconsistent with the visual evidence even when the final answer is correct, and program-based distillation [ 37 ] mitigates this inconsistency through executable verification. CLOSER adapts Qwen2.5-VL-7B with LoRA and keeps a base-model rationale only when its label is correct and a rule-based validator accepts it, so an external teacher annotates only the remaining samples (Sec. III-D3 ). Rendering novel viewpoints with 3D Gaussian Splatting also improves the viewpoint robustness of VLN agents [ 38 ] ; likewise, CLOSER renders confusers as hard negatives and refines the perceiver on its residual errors (Sec. III-D2 ).

CL-CoTNav [32] 微调了有关层次性思维链说明的VLM, 以说明ObjectNav决定的理由, 将封闭源代码教师的理由提炼成开放模式, 现在成为标准做法 [33,34] 。 蒸馏也用于压缩导航模型: 陈等. [35] 分馏到哪里去寻找以及如何从老师转移到一个93%参数少的学生. 然而,CURE [36] 表明,即使最终答案正确,VLM的原理也可能与视觉证据不一致,基于程序蒸馏[37]通过可执行的验证减轻这种不一致. CLOSER将Quen2.5-VL-7B与LORA相适应,只有当其标签正确且基于规则的校验者接受时,才保留一个基模原理,因此外部老师只给剩余样本做注释(Sec. III-D3 ). 用3D Gaussian Splateting来渲染新颖的观点,也提高了VLN代理商的观点稳健性[38];同样,CLOSER也使混淆者成为硬底片,并完善了对其剩余错误的感知器(Sec. III-D2 ).

blocks.en: II-C Active Perception and Uncertainty-Driven Exploration
blocks.zh: II-C 主动感知和不确定性驱动探索

blocks.en: Active perception selects sensor placements to maximize information gain. Next-best-view (NBV) methods optimize hand-crafted metrics [ 39 ] or predict the downstream value of prospective viewpoints [ 40 , 41 ] . Uncertainty-aware methods complement view selection through conformal prediction [ 42 ] and uncertainty-driven intrinsic motivation [ 43 ] , and recent work applies them to open-vocabulary object search [ 44 ] . Diffusion models have also become expressive policy representations that capture multimodal action distributions [ 16 ] and generate navigation trajectories [ 45 ] . The approach policy of CLOSER connects these two lines without an explicit information-gain objective (Sec. III-E ). A Diffusion Transformer [ 17 ] distilled from privileged expert trajectories takes only the candidate mask and depth as input, and the verification stack decides from the newly acquired views whether the evidence suffices.
blocks.zh: 主动感知选择传感器放置,以最大限度地增加信息收益. NBV(NBV)方法优化手工制作的度量衡 [39] 或预测未来值的下游值 [40,41]. 不确定性-认知方法通过向导预测[42]和不确定性驱动的内在动机[43]来补充视图选择,最近的工作将其应用于开源对象搜索[44]. 传播模式也成为体现性的政策表述,能够捕捉多式联运分布[16]并产生导航轨迹[45]. CLOSER的方法政策将这两条线连接在一起,但没有明确的信息获取目标(Sec. III-E.). 从特权专家轨迹中蒸馏出来的扩散变形器[17]只取候选口罩和深度作为输入,验证堆根据新获得的观点决定证据是否足够.

blocks.en: III-A Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 三-A 问题的提出

blocks.en: We consider the standard ObjectNav setting, in which an agent placed in a previously unseen indoor environment must find an instance of a given target category c c . At each step, the agent receives an egocentric RGB-D observation together with its pose relative to the start of the episode. It then executes either a discrete movement action or the stop action, which ends the episode. The episode succeeds if the agent calls the stop action within 1 1 m of an instance of the target category under a budget of 500 500 steps.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,标准ObjectNav设定,即放置在先前未见室内环境中的物剂必须找到特定目标类别c c 的实例。 每一步,代理都收到以自我为中心的RGB-D观察,以及相对于剧集开始的姿势. 然后它要么执行离散的移动动作,要么执行停止动作,结束剧集. 该集成功,如果代理在500500步的预算下,在目标类别的1 1米以内调用停止行动.

blocks.en: A candidate event begins with the detection of a candidate for the target category and ends when the agent decides to stop at the candidate or to reject it and resume exploration. The agent may defer this decision to gather further views of the candidate. The event ends without a decision if the agent loses track of the candidate or the episode terminates first. Since deferral consumes steps from the episode budget, the goal in each event is to reach a correct decision with as few deferral steps as possible.

blocks.en: III-B Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 三-B 框架概览

blocks.en: CLOSER controls the agent only during a candidate event, so the host ObjectNav system keeps its exploration and mapping modules unchanged. As shown in Fig. 2 , the candidate is tracked across frames, and a CLIP-based diversity gate maintains an evidence cache of complementary views. The single-view perceiver is a fine-tuned VLM that predicts tri-state probabilities for each retained view ( yes for a target, no for a non-target, and uncertain for insufficient evidence). A lightweight MLP fuses these probabilities into a tri-state decision (Sec. III-C ). The perceiver and the MLP are trained offline on labels that encode both the semantic identity and the evidence sufficiency of each detection (Sec. III-D ). If the fused decision is uncertain , the agent enters the approach phase, in which the approach policy generates a local trajectory toward the candidate from its tracked mask and depth. The policy is trained to imitate expert trajectories planned on a privileged navigability map (Sec. III-E ). Views retained along the local trajectory update the fused decision, so the agent can end the approach phase before reaching the candidate (Sec. III-F ).

blocks.en: III-C Tri-State Verification Stack
blocks.zh: 三国核查堆栈

blocks.en: At each step t t of a candidate event, the verification stack outputs a fused decision y t ∈ 𝒴 = { yes , uncertain , no } y_{t}\in\mathcal{Y}=\{\texttt{yes},\texttt{uncertain},\texttt{no}\} from the cached views. An uncertain decision indicates that these views support neither yes nor no , so targets and confusers alike can receive it. A binary verifier can also defer by withholding its decision whenever its confidence falls below a threshold. However, the threshold is selected on the validation split and is thus tied to the confidence distribution of that split. When this distribution shifts at deployment, confident predictions on insufficient views can exceed the threshold and become forced decisions, while no labels are available to re-tune the threshold. Moreover, a low confidence does not indicate whether additional views of the candidate would enable a decision. CLOSER therefore supervises uncertain as an explicit class. The training labels of this class are derived from view conditions that the agent can improve by moving, namely the image scale, truncation or occlusion, and viewing distance of the candidate (Sec. III-D1 ).

blocks.en: III-D 2 Detector-Aligned Data and Render Augmentation
blocks.zh: III-D 2 探测器对齐数据和渲染增强

blocks.en: Natural training data come from collection trajectories that follow shortest paths through HM3D [ 20 ] training scenes in Habitat [ 48 ] . Grounded-SAM runs on sampled frames, and each detection is labeled by Eq. ( 8 ). These data populate the four regimes of Table I unevenly. Most non-target detections are easy to reject, whereas sufficient views of confusers are scarce and insufficient views of confusers are rarer still. We therefore supplement these two regimes with rendered confusers, such as a sofa for the target bed or a stool for the target chair (Verifier Training panel of Fig. 2 ). Each confuser is rendered with varied camera distance, azimuth, image-plane placement, and occlusion, so that it is observed in both sufficient and insufficient views. Rendered frames pass through the same detector and labeling function as natural frames. A rendered frame therefore yields a training sample only when Grounded-SAM identifies the confuser as a candidate for the target category, and the sample is labeled from the detected mask.

blocks.en: During the approach phase, the approach policy π ϕ \pi_{\phi} generates waypoints toward the candidate. blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets and evaluation splits. We evaluate navigation in Habitat on the standard validation episodes of Gibson [ 50 ] (1,000 episodes), HM3D v1 (2,000), and HM3D v2 [ 51 , 20 ] (1,000). The verification stack is trained, refined, validated, and tested on scene-disjoint HM3D splits, and the approach policy is trained on expert demonstrations from the same training scenes. MP3D [ 52 ] uses a 21-category protocol, whereas the stack is trained on the six categories shared by Gibson and HM3D, so MP3D serves only for the candidate-level distribution-shift evaluation of Table VI .
blocks.zh: 数据集和评价分开。 我们评价栖息地的导航在Gibson[50](1,000集)、HM3D v1(2,000)和HM3D v2[51,20](1,000)的标准验证事件。 校验堆在现场-脱节HM3D分机上经过训练,精炼,验证,测试,方法政策从同一训练场景对专家演示进行培训. MP3D [52] 使用21类协议,而堆栈则对吉布森和HM3D共有的6类进行训练,因此MP3D只用于表六候选级别的分配轮值评价.

blocks.en: Metrics. At the episode level, we report success rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) [ 53 ] ; closed-loop results are means over three evaluation seeds. Every failed episode is attributed to exactly one cause, in priority order: false stop (FS), where the episode terminates by accepting a non-target; false reject (FR), where at least one true-target candidate is detected and then rejected or abandoned; exploration failure, where no true target is detected within the budget; or other, covering timeouts with a pending candidate and collision-induced termination. Episode-level FS and FR are therefore exclusive shares of all episodes. Candidate-level FS and FR are instead class-conditional rates: FS is the fraction of non-target candidate events accepted with yes , and FR is the fraction of target candidate events rejected with no ; events that end in abandonment or episode termination with a pending candidate remain in the denominator but enter neither numerator. In the approach phase, a candidate is correctly resolved only if a correct yes / no decision is reached before the close-range fallback; fallback-triggered decisions, track loss, abandonment, and episode termination with a pending candidate do not count as correct resolution.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 在剧集一级,我们报告成功率(SR)和成功率按路径长度加权(SPL)[53];闭路结果是指超过三个评价种子。 每一个失败的剧集都归结于一个原因,按优先级顺序排列:假停(FS),即该剧集通过接受非目标而终止;假拒绝(FR),即至少发现一个真实目标候选人,然后拒绝或放弃;探索失败,即预算内没有发现真正的目标;或者其他,涵盖与待选候选人的超时和碰撞引发的终止. 因此,Episode级FS和FR是所有剧集的专属股权. 考生的FS和FR则属于有条件等级: FS是非目标候选人赛事中以"是"为接受的一小部分,FR是目标候选人赛事中以"否"为拒绝的一小部分;以弃赛或与待决候选人的分赛终止为结束的赛事仍留在分母中,但没有输入数字. 在方法阶段,只有在近距离倒计时前正确是/没有做出任何决定时,才正确解决候选人的问题;倒计时决定、追踪丢失、放弃和与待决候选人的分期终止不能算作正确的解决。

blocks.en: Baselines and system integration. The eight baselines span end-to-end and modular ObjectNav systems based on learned policies, semantic exploration, frontier scoring, value maps, topological reasoning, and target-centric fusion. CLOSER attaches to each as a self-contained verification layer that runs its own Grounded-SAM, ByteTrack, and SAM (Sec. III-F ) on the RGB-D stream of the baseline, so every system receives candidates from the same detection-and-tracking pipeline. Exploration, mapping, and the low-level planner remain unchanged, and CLOSER replaces only the native stopping rule. The 500-step budget, action space, and success criterion of each dataset are likewise unchanged, so verification steps, including the approach phase, count against the same budget. Simulator annotations are used only for training labels and privileged expert construction. Systems with an LLM decision module use the same locally deployed Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 model across datasets.
blocks.zh: 基线和系统整合。 八个基线覆盖基于学到的政策、语义探索、前沿评分、价值图、地形推理和以目标为中心的聚变的端对端和模块化对象Nav系统。 CLOSER将每个都作为自成一体的核查层,在基线的RGB-D流上运行自己的Grounded-SAM,ByteTrack,以及SAM(Sec. III-F),因此每个系统都接收同一检测和跟踪管道的候选者. 勘探,测绘,低层规划师保持不变,CLOSER只取代本土停机规则. 每个数据集的500步预算、行动空间和成功标准同样没有变化,因此,核查步骤,包括方法阶段,都算在同一预算。 模拟说明只用于培训标签和特权专家建设. 具有LLM决策模块的系统使用同一本地部署的Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507模型跨数据集.

blocks.en: IV-C Failure Cause Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-C 失败原因分析

blocks.en: We analyze native VLFM on HM3D v2 using the episode-level failure attribution of Sec. IV-A . Its SR is 63.6%, with 19.4% false stops and 13.8% false rejects. These stop-attributable causes sum to 33.2 percentage points of the overall 36.4% failure rate, so the stopping decision accounts for over 90% of the failures; exploration and other failures account for the remaining 3.2 points.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Sec. IV-A的插曲级失败归属分析HM3D v2上的原生VLFM. 它的SR为63.6%,其中19.4%为虚假停留,13.8%为虚假拒绝. 这些可停产造成36.4%的失败率的33.2%,因此,停止决定占失败率的90%以上;勘探和其他失败占剩下的3.2个百分点。

blocks.en: CLOSER reduces the stop-attributable failures by more than half, from 33.2 to 15.7 points, with false stops falling to 6.4% and false rejects to 9.3%, and SR increases to 66.1%. Preventing an early false stop or false reject allows navigation to continue, and some of the continued episodes subsequently time out, collide, or end with a pending candidate. The exploration/other share therefore rises from 3.2% to 18.2%, and more than half of the remaining failures fall outside the stopping decision that CLOSER addresses.
blocks.zh: CLOSER将可停止的故障减少一半以上,从33.2分降至15.7分,虚假停止降至6.4%,虚假拒绝降至9.3%,SR则增至66.1%。 防止过早的假停或假拒绝可以继续导航,一些续发事件随后暂停、碰撞或与待定候选人结束。 因此,勘探/其他份额从3.2%上升到18.2%,其余的失败有一半以上不属于CLOSER处理的停止决定范围。

blocks.en: Fig. 4 shows how the closed loop prevents both error types in one successful episode with target category sofa . In the first candidate event, the fused decision on the initial view at step 34 is uncertain , so the agent enters the approach phase. The view retained at step 37 shows that the candidate is a bed; the fused decision becomes no , and the agent discards the candidate and resumes exploration instead of ending the episode with a false stop. In the second event, the initial view at step 63 is likewise deferred, and two further views retained at steps 72 and 75 add evidence during the approach phase until the fused decision becomes yes . The agent then calls the stop action, and the episode succeeds. In the navigation context of Fig. 4 (b), the colored segments of the top-down path mark the steps spanned by the two events, and the black segments correspond to exploration by the baseline. Neither map in the panel is an input to CLOSER (Sec. III-E ).

In both scenes, stacked blocks occlude the candidate at the initial viewpoint, so the initial views are deferred; as the robot moves around the blocks, clearer views enter the cache, and the fused decision becomes decisive once the candidate is fully visible. blocks.en: Table IV compares the native VLFM stopping rule, two binary verifiers, tri-state verification without the approach policy, and the complete system on the same HM3D v2 episodes. Binary GPT-4o-mini follows the API-based verification of prior work [ 11 ] ; the local binary variant uses the same cache implementation but has no uncertain state, so its first decision terminates the candidate event. The static tri-state variant keeps the candidate tracked while VLFM continues to explore and recomputes the fused decision whenever the cache admits a new view, without a dedicated approach policy; the close-range fallback still applies if VLFM brings the agent within 1 m of the candidate. blocks.en: The binary API and local verifiers reduce false stops from 19.4% to 11.2% and 13.6%, respectively, but improve SR by at most 1.3 points. The local binary variant also increases false rejects from 13.8% to 14.2%, since it has no deferral state and must assign a binary outcome when the available evidence is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 二进制API和当地的校验者分别将假停机率从19.4%降低到11.2%和13.6%,但在最高1.3点上提高了SR. 本地二进制变体还将假拒绝率从13.8%增加到14.2%,因为它没有延迟状态,必须在现有证据不足时指定二进制结果.

blocks.en: Adding an uncertain state without the approach policy further reduces false stops to 8.7%, while false rejects increase to 15.1%: deferred target candidates are abandoned when the views that VLFM subsequently observes do not provide sufficient evidence. With the approach policy, false stops and false rejects decrease to 6.4% and 9.3%, and SR/SPL reach 66.1/34.1 (Fig. 6 ). During the approach phase, the agent acquires additional views of deferred candidates, which accounts for the reduction in false rejects relative to the static tri-state variant. The complete system triggers the close-range fallback in 9.8% of episodes; fallback-induced false stops and false rejects are included in the reported rates.
blocks.zh: 在没有方针政策的情况下添加不确定状态进一步将假停留降至8.7%,而假拒绝则增至15.1%:当VLFM随后观察到的观点没有提供足够的证据时,推迟的目标候选人会被放弃. 根据方针政策,假停车和假拒发率下降到6.4%和9.3%,SR/SPL达到66.1/34.1(图6)。 在接触阶段,代理人获取对被推迟候选人的额外观点,这说明相对于静态三态变体,假拒绝的减少. 完整的系统在9.8%的剧集中触发了近距离倒计时;倒计时引发的假停计时和假拒绝计时计入报告率.

blocks.en: On VLFM with CLOSER, the remaining episode-level false stops and false rejects are 6.4% and 9.3%, respectively (Table IV ). Qualitative inspection identifies three recurrent modes.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We presented CLOSER, an evidence-aware active visual verification framework that treats the terminal decision of object-goal navigation as a closed-loop evidence acquisition problem rather than a one-shot binary filter. A CLIP gate maintains four complementary views, a locally deployable single-view VLM reports their raw tri-state probabilities, and a lightweight MLP learns when the chronologically ordered cache supports a category commitment; a privileged-to-observation Diffusion Transformer learns how to acquire a more informative view from only the tracked mask and depth. Inserted as a plug-in layer, CLOSER consistently improves success rate and path efficiency across heterogeneous ObjectNav harnesses; ablations show that the full gain requires the closed loop, since deferral without resolution reduces false stops but raises false rejects. Looking ahead, extending evidence-aware deferral from candidate verification to exploration commitments, and validating the mask-and-depth policy on physical platforms, are natural next steps toward irreversible decisions under partial observability.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了CLOSER,这是一个有证据意识的主动视觉核查框架,将对象-目标导航的终端决定视为一个闭路证据获取问题,而不是一枪二进制过滤器。 一个CLIP门维持四个互补视图,一个本地可部署的单视VLM报告其原始的三态概率,一个轻量级的MLP学习当按时间顺序订购的缓存支持一个类别承诺时;一个特权到观察的传播变形器学习如何只从跟踪的面具和深度获取一个更丰富的视图. 作为插件层插入,CLOSER不断提高各种ObjectNav带的成功率和路径效率;崩盘显示,完全收益需要闭环,因为没有解析的延迟会减少假停车,但会引起假拒绝. 展望未来,将证据意识从候选核查推迟到勘探承诺,并验证关于物理平台的掩盖和深入政策,是在部分可观察的情况下朝着不可逆转的决定迈出的自然的下一步。
